name: get_customer_summary
description: Return the order count and total spend in EUR for one customer. Use this before listing orders when the user asks how much a customer has spent.

customer_id.description: Customer identifier in the form C-123456

name: list_customer_orders
description: Return one page of a customer's orders, newest first. Pass next_token from the previous result to get the next page. At most 25 orders are returned per call.

customer_id.description: Customer identifier in the form C-123456

limit.description: Orders per page, 1 to 25. Defaults to 10.

next_token.description: Opaque token from the previous page. Omit for the first page.
